openQuestions.q: Should B-eb18 implement the Proof Admissibility Appendix D admissibility_waterline/equivalent entry point now, or is rendering unavailable/unknown an intentional exclusion owned by a separate Proof Admissibility story?
openQuestions.evidence: The global control-plane CP-2 task says to consume lattice admissibility_waterline if implemented or implement Appendix D verbatim, while the B-eb18 PLAN says no implemented admissibility_waterline API exists and renders the capability unavailable/unknown.
openQuestions.resolution: Resolved in scope: because the user asked to complete the whole global lifecycle control plane plan, B-eb18 will implement the Proof Admissibility Appendix D minimum admissibility_waterline entry point as diagnostic-only output, then have the CP-2 control-plane consumption projector consume that waterline. It remains non-authoritative and cannot promote candidate, diagnostic, legacy, or local proof into DONE or production completion.
